fields.scope: Owner, month, environment, route and job
fields.idempotency_key: Same external effect cannot reserve twice
fields.price_snapshot: Provider, model, region, rate version and checked time
fields.worst_case_gross_usd: Decimal: inputs, maximum outputs, tools, cache writes, retries and batch liability
fields.verified_credit_allocation_id: Nullable. When absent, optional Claude dispatch is refused.
fields.reserved_credit_usd: Decimal. MP-local reservation against a proven allocated slice only; zero admissible credit until trustworthy organisation-wide allocation and freshness are established.
fields.fx_bound_gbp_per_usd: Decimal conservative conversion with source age
fields.tax_card_bounds: Decimal fractions, linked to invoice evidence or explicit assumptions
fields.worst_case_cash_gbp: Decimal cash liability after verified eligible credit
fields.expires_at: Admission expiry; not proof that external billing stopped
fields.org_wide_credit_allocation_proof: Required, currently unproven evidence of a cooperative or otherwise enforceable allocation and coverage despite other applications. MP-local records cannot control unrelated spending.
fields.fixed_commitments: Selected invoices with full amount, currency, due month, tax/card/FX bound and settlement/cancellation state; no annual amortisation in cash admission. This draft establishes no actual purchase or invoice.

invariants: Global, environment and route reservations change atomically under concurrency.
Without sufficient verified credit, refuse optional Claude regardless of cash headroom.

Cross-application exclusion of consumed, reserved and uncertain credits is a required organisation-wide cooperative/enforceable capability, currently unproven. MP-local reservations alone cannot provide it; without trustworthy allocation and freshness proof, refuse optional Claude dispatch.
Settlement replaces reservation liability; it does not double-count the same expense.
Fixed subscriptions remain committed until cancellation is effective.
Counterfactual full-function no-credit costs are not permitted paid-call forecasts.
Expiry, scope, freshness or coverage failure denies model dispatch.
Emergency policy does not bypass owner authority or the GBP100 aggregate envelope.

A full fixed annual invoice is encumbered in its due month before optional jobs. Amortised run rates never replace invoice-month cash; release only on confirmed settlement or effective cancellation. Unknown amount or due date blocks a new commitment until conservatively bounded and authorised.
Exactly one exception exists: the Apple Developer Program fee in its due month, if the owner buys it. It never extends to another fee, another month or the rest of that month's lines.
The top-5 scan spends at most GBP5 a month from the same aggregate month; exceeding the cap refuses the scan work rather than raising the cap.

credit_proof_boundary.distinction: Usage/billing collection cadence is separate from the proposed admission-proof freshness bound. If trustworthy proof cannot be obtained, deny dispatch.

cash_admission.scope: Both workload accounts, data, model/evaluation and selected ancillary fixed invoices share the aggregate month. Reserve a full selected annual invoice in its due month; projected monthly savings or amortisation do not reduce its liability. Unknown timing/amount needs a conservative approved bound before new commitment.

exception_month.rule: Owner, 2 Nov 2026: the Apple Developer Program fee (USD99 a membership year) may take its due month above GBP100, for this fee only. Owner, 3 Nov 2026: not bought for now. If bought, the full fee is reserved in its due month, never amortised; every other line in that month must still fit the ceiling and thresholds, and no other fee or month may use the exception. The month's record keeps threshold flags on the full month including the fee (fixed finding R1-C1) and shows the remainder, every other line, separately with its own flags (remaining_* in costs/model.json). Whether optional jobs in that month pause on the full-month flags or run while the remainder sits under GBP60/75/85 is open for the owner (COST-Q4); until answered, the full-month flags stand.

cash_admission.scan_allowance_rule: Owner, 3 Nov 2026 (MP-39 item 19): the ~150-name scan and its top-5 explanations may add up to GBP5 a month. It is a reserved cap inside the same month, not a separate pot: a scan reservation that would take the month's scan spend past GBP5 is refused, and it does not relax the Claude credit rule.
cash_admission.domain_line: Removed (owner, 3 Nov 2026): mypaisapp.com is renewed outside MP, so no domain commitment is reserved.
